Bringing You Our Best
The Mennel Milling Company
Trusted since 1886.
Integrated Flour Milling & Bakery Mix Network
Delivery you can count on.
With flour mills strategically located across multiple states, Mennel provides flour supply security our customers can truly count on.
Our flour milling and bakery mix network promotes consistent quality and seamless continuity. Even when conditions change or challenges arise, we deliver the same dependable product when and where you need it.
As a trusted flour supplier, Mennel serves bakeries, food manufacturers, and industrial baking operations with reliable flour distribution and customized ingredient solutions. Our network helps ensure a stable supply of premium grain-based products including wheat flour and bakery mixes across the U.S.
Using advanced milling technology and strict food safety standards, Mennel produces high-quality flour for a wide range of baking applications, including breads, pizza crusts, cookies, pastries, and snack products. With dependable logistics and responsive customer support, we help customers maintain production and reduce supply chain disruptions with reliable flour delivery and consistent performance.
Learn more about Our Locations and capabilities across the company.
Our Story
1886 - 2026
For more than 140 years, Mennel has built a legacy of stability, quality, and trusted service in the flour milling industry. Since 1886, our growth has been guided by five generations of family leadership and the dedication of more than 1,000 employees.
Today, Mennel operates over 30 locations across 7 states, including state-of-the-art flour mills, grain elevators, trucking companies, and bakery mix facilities. Our integrated network allows us to provide dependable flour supply, consistent product quality, and reliable transportation solutions for bakeries, food manufacturers, and commercial baking operations across the United States.
With a strong foundation and continued investment in innovation and food safety, Mennel remains committed to delivering the consistency and supply security customers have trusted for generations.
Watch the Flour Power Video and the impact our team makes each and every day.
Our Values
Our values guide the way we serve our customers, employees, and communities every day. Built on a foundation of integrity and reliability, we are committed to delivering trusted flour milling solutions and dependable partnerships that strengthen the industries and communities we serve.
Quality
We are committed to producing the finest flour and bakery mixes because Mennel has set the standard.
Uniformity
We deliver consistent quality flour and bakery mixes that our customers can count on for the best every day.
Service
We bring a special level of care and support to everything we do because it's how we've operated since 1886.
Life is Good Working Here
Mennel offers many rewarding careers.
We produce the best quality flour and bakery mixes that are essential to the foods people enjoy every day – from breads and cereals to biscuits, cookies, and cakes. Every individual on the Mennel team has an important role in ensuring that we bring our best to the world's food chain.
